products.title: Ambri Apple Plant
products.description: Authentic Ambri apple variety from Kashmir. Rich flavor and aroma. Famous export quality.

growing_instructions: Plant bare-root saplings during dormant season from December to February or potted plants in March.
Fragrant spring blossom blankets trees in April, followed by active shoot extension through June.
Kashmir's legendary Ambri apples mature and harvest from late September through October.
Perform structural winter pruning and dormant copper sprays in January and February.
care_instructions: Irrigate deeply every 7-10 days in dry months; reduce during monsoon and winter dormancy.
Apply compost and balanced NPK in late winter, then top-dress after fruit set.
Prune during dormancy to keep an open framework and remove dead or crossing wood.
Use preventive copper/sulfur sprays at bud break where scab/canker pressure is high.

symbolism.origin: The indigenous Ambri apple is the legendary heirloom queen of Kashmir's fruit orchards, revered for its crisp sweetness, perfumed fragrance, and heritage hospitality.

products.title: Apricot (Hybrid)
products.description: A deciduous fruit tree grown for its attractive spring blossoms and sweet, golden-orange apricots. Suitable for sunny gardens and orchards, its fruits can be enjoyed fresh or used in jams, preserves, and desserts. Fruit quality, ripening time, and yield depend on the hybrid variety and growing conditions.

growing_instructions: Plant in well-drained soil in a sunny, open location with sufficient space for the tree to mature.
Plant bare-root trees during dormancy, generally in late winter or early spring when the soil is workable and before active growth begins.
Apricot trees flower in spring, but early blossoms can be damaged by late frosts. Choose a site with good air drainage and avoid frost pockets.
Fruit typically ripens during summer, with the exact harvest period depending on the cultivar, elevation, and local climate.
Provide regular moisture while young trees establish and during fruit development, avoiding waterlogged soil.
Prune lightly to establish an open, balanced framework and remove dead, damaged, or crossing branches.
care_instructions: Water deeply when the soil begins to dry, adjusting frequency for rainfall, temperature, and soil drainage rather than relying on a fixed weekly schedule.
Apply mature compost around the root zone without piling it against the trunk, and use additional fertilizer only as needed.
Maintain a light mulch layer to conserve soil moisture and regulate root-zone temperature.
Avoid heavy pruning and unnecessary pruning during wet weather, as apricot trees can be susceptible to wood diseases.
Monitor for aphids, fungal diseases, and signs of branch dieback; use appropriate treatments only when necessary and follow product instructions.

symbolism.origin: Apricot trees are valued in many fruit-growing cultures for their spring blossoms and golden summer harvest. Their seasonal cycle inspires associations with prosperity, renewal, abundance, and longevity.

products.title: Black Grapes Plant
products.description: Premium black grape variety with large, juicy fruits. Excellent for fresh eating and wine production.

growing_instructions: Plant dormant rooted vines in February or March along sturdy trellises.
Vigorous shoot and cane growth runs from May through July.
Dark grape clusters sweeten and harvest from late August through September.
Prune dormant canes back to 2-3 buds in January or February while vine is dormant.
care_instructions: Water weekly during active growth; increase slightly at berry set and reduce near ripening.
Mulch the root zone to conserve moisture and suppress weeds.
Thin dense clusters and side shoots to improve airflow and reduce rot risk.
Prune hard in dormancy; remove diseased canes immediately.

symbolism.origin: In classical Mediterranean, Persian, and biblical traditions, grapevines represent community, celebration, divine blessing, and sweet communion.

products.title: Cherry Plant
products.description: Sweet Kashmir cherry variety. Dark red juicy fruits. Perfect for valley climate.

growing_instructions: Plant bare-root trees in well-drained valley soil during January and February.
Spectacular white blossom blankets trees in mid-April.
World-famous Kashmiri cherries (Mishri, Makhmali, Double) harvest rapidly in June and early July.
Prune lightly in late summer after harvest to prevent fungal gummosis; dormant Nov-Feb.
care_instructions: Irrigate deeply every 7-10 days in dry months; reduce during monsoon and winter dormancy.
Apply compost and balanced NPK in late winter, then top-dress after fruit set.
Prune during dormancy to keep an open framework and remove dead or crossing wood.
Use preventive copper/sulfur sprays at bud break where scab/canker pressure is high.

symbolism.origin: Prized in Kashmir's spring bloom and celebrated globally; the cherry blossom and ripening ruby fruit represent spring renewal, good fortune, and youthful zest.

products.title: Fig Plant
products.description: Sweet fig variety with tender, juicy fruits. Prolific bearer in warm climates. Excellent fresh or dried.

growing_instructions: Plant in sheltered south-facing garden locations in March or April.
Canopy fills out from May to July with rapid breba and main crop fig set.
Sweet figs ripen and harvest from August through October.
Wrap young trunks or mulch heavily against severe sub-zero frosts from December to February.
care_instructions: Water deeply every 7-10 days in dry weather, especially during fruit swell.
Mulch with organic matter but keep mulch away from the stem base.
Prune lightly in winter to remove weak and crossing branches.
Harvest fruits when neck softens and skin color deepens; do not pull unripe figs.

symbolism.origin: One of the earliest cultivated trees, sacred across Mediterranean and Middle Eastern antiquity; symbolizes peace, spiritual abundance, and enlightenment.

products.title: Green Grapes Plant
products.description: Crisp and refreshing green grape variety. Sweet flavor and thin-skinned fruits. Perfect for fresh consumption.

growing_instructions: Plant bare-root vines in February or March in deep, sunny, gravelly soil.
Canopy and fruit clusters develop vigorously from May to July.
Crisp green grape bunches harvest from late August through September.
Perform spur pruning during deep winter dormancy in January and February.
care_instructions: Water weekly during active growth; increase slightly at berry set and reduce near ripening.
Mulch the root zone to conserve moisture and suppress weeds.
Thin dense clusters and side shoots to improve airflow and reduce rot risk.
Prune hard in dormancy; remove diseased canes immediately.

symbolism.origin: Clusters of sweet green grapes represent vital harvest, fruitful fellowship, joy, and agricultural plenty in autumn orchards.

products.title: Lemon Plant
products.description: Highly productive lemon variety with acidic, juicy fruits. Excellent for culinary use and year-round harvesting.

growing_instructions: Plant in deep terracotta pots in April or May after spring frosts end.
Aromatic blooms and fruit set occur from May through August in sunny spots.
Cannot survive Kashmir's sub-zero snow and frost outdoors; must be sheltered in a heated veranda or indoors from November through March.
Water moderately during winter; harvest mature yellow lemons in winter indoors.
care_instructions: Water every 5-7 days in summer and every 10-14 days in cool months.
Feed with compost and split citrus fertilizer doses from Feb to Sep.
Remove rootstock suckers and only lightly prune crowded interior shoots.
Monitor for leaf miner, aphids, and scale; control early with neem or recommended IPM options.

symbolism.origin: In Mediterranean and South Asian folklore, bright lemons embody purification, uplifting energy, longevity, and heartfelt devotion.

products.title: Orange Plant
products.description: Sweet orange variety with juicy, seedless fruits. Prolific bearer. Excellent for fresh juice and eating.

growing_instructions: Plant in well-drained citrus soil containers in April or May.
Flushes new growth and fragrant blossoms from May to July.
Sub-zero Kashmir winters will kill outdoor citrus; move indoors or into polyhouse protection from November to March.
Fruit ripens indoors over winter; harvest from December to February.
care_instructions: Water every 5-7 days in summer and every 10-14 days in cool months.
Feed with compost and split citrus fertilizer doses from Feb to Sep.
Remove rootstock suckers and only lightly prune crowded interior shoots.
Monitor for leaf miner, aphids, and scale; control early with neem or recommended IPM options.

symbolism.origin: Orange blossoms and golden fruit have historically been carried in bridal traditions to symbolize fertility, generosity, sweet prosperity, and good luck.

products.title: Peach Plant
products.description: Juicy Kashmir peach variety. Sweet and fragrant fruits. Thrives in temperate climate.

growing_instructions: Plant bare-root trees in January or February during winter dormancy.
Stunning pink blossoms open in late March to early April.
Juicy peaches ripen and harvest from July through August.
Prune into open-center vase shape in February to maximize sun penetration; dormant Dec-Feb.
care_instructions: Irrigate deeply every 7-10 days in dry months; reduce during monsoon and winter dormancy.
Apply compost and balanced NPK in late winter, then top-dress after fruit set.
Prune during dormancy to keep an open framework and remove dead or crossing wood.
Use preventive copper/sulfur sprays at bud break where scab/canker pressure is high.

symbolism.origin: In Persian, Chinese, and Kashmiri folklore, the peach tree is the premier symbol of longevity, spring rebirth, and deep friendship.

products.title: Pear Plant
products.description: Sweet pear variety with juicy, fragrant fruits. Ideal for temperate climates. Excellent for fresh eating and preservation.

growing_instructions: Plant bare-root saplings during dormant months from December to February.
White blossoms appear in mid-April along with initial fruit set.
Crisp Kashmiri Nak and Babgousha pears harvest from August through September.
Conduct dormant corrective pruning in January and February.
care_instructions: Irrigate deeply every 7-10 days in dry months; reduce during monsoon and winter dormancy.
Apply compost and balanced NPK in late winter, then top-dress after fruit set.
Prune during dormancy to keep an open framework and remove dead or crossing wood.
Use preventive copper/sulfur sprays at bud break where scab/canker pressure is high.

symbolism.origin: Pear trees blossom in snowy clouds and live for centuries; historically symbolizing comfort, enduring affection, and wise longevity.

products.title: Plum Plant
products.description: Juicy plum variety with sweet, flavorful fruits. Excellent for fresh eating and preserves. Self-pollinating.

growing_instructions: Plant bare-root stock in January or February before buds swell.
Prolific white blossoms emerge in early April.
Plums develop rapidly and harvest from late June through August.
Prune lightly in late winter or early spring in February to avoid disease infection.
care_instructions: Irrigate deeply every 7-10 days in dry months; reduce during monsoon and winter dormancy.
Apply compost and balanced NPK in late winter, then top-dress after fruit set.
Prune during dormancy to keep an open framework and remove dead or crossing wood.
Use preventive copper/sulfur sprays at bud break where scab/canker pressure is high.

symbolism.origin: The plum tree blossoms bravely in early spring while snow still covers the mountain branches, symbolizing resilience through winter, hope, and courage.

products.title: Pomegranate Plant
products.description: Ancient fruit variety with jewel-like ruby arils. Versatile culinary uses and ornamental flowers. Excellent for warm climates.

growing_instructions: Plant container-grown saplings in warm, sunny locations in March or April.
Bright scarlet trumpet flowers bloom from May through July.
Pomegranate fruits ripen on bushes for harvest in September and October.
Prune suckers and crossing branches in February; sheds leaves and overwinters dormant Nov-Feb.
care_instructions: Irrigate regularly at flowering and fruit set; avoid moisture extremes to reduce cracking.
Remove excess suckers from the base several times a year.
Prune lightly in winter to renew fruiting wood.
Bag or protect fruits in bird-prone sites near ripening.

symbolism.origin: The ruby-arilled pomegranate is one of the most sacred fruits of antiquity, revered in Persian and Kashmiri lore as the universal emblem of fertility and prosperity.

products.title: Quince Apple Plant
products.description: Aromatic quince apple variety with fragrant, golden fruits. Perfect for jams, jellies, and preserves.

growing_instructions: Plant bare-root or potted trees in fertile loamy ground in February or March.
Delicate pink-white blooms appear in late April.
Traditional aromatic Kashmiri quince (Bumchoonth) fruits mature and harvest in October.
Prune crossing interior branches in January or February; fully hardy through valley winters.
care_instructions: Irrigate deeply every 7-10 days in dry months; reduce during monsoon and winter dormancy.
Apply compost and balanced NPK in late winter, then top-dress after fruit set.
Prune during dormancy to keep an open framework and remove dead or crossing wood.
Use preventive copper/sulfur sprays at bud break where scab/canker pressure is high.

symbolism.origin: Known as 'Bamtsunt' in Kashmir and sacred to Venus in ancient Greece, the golden quince was the historic golden apple gifted to declare true love and marital happiness.

products.title: Red Gala Apple Plant
products.description: Premium red Gala apple variety with crisp, sweet fruits. Excellent for fresh eating and export quality.

growing_instructions: Plant bare-root high-density saplings in December to February or container plants in March.
Flower bloom takes place across mid-April in valley orchards.
Sweet, crisp Red Gala apples color up and harvest from late August to mid-September.
Prune for central leader spindle form in January and February.
care_instructions: Irrigate deeply every 7-10 days in dry months; reduce during monsoon and winter dormancy.
Apply compost and balanced NPK in late winter, then top-dress after fruit set.
Prune during dormancy to keep an open framework and remove dead or crossing wood.
Use preventive copper/sulfur sprays at bud break where scab/canker pressure is high.

symbolism.origin: The crisp red apple is the universal symbol of health, knowledge, generous harvest, and youthful vitality in orchards.

products.title: Strawberry Plant
products.description: Sweet strawberry variety suited to Kashmir climate. Bears fruit in first year.

growing_instructions: Plant bare-root crowns or runners in September-October or early spring in March.
Flowers profusely in April as spring warms the valley soil.
Sweet strawberries ripen in abundance from May through June.
Mulch beds with pine needles or straw before December to insulate crowns from frost heave.
care_instructions: Provide frequent light irrigation; avoid waterlogging and wet foliage at night.
Feed lightly but regularly with compost tea or balanced soluble nutrition.
Remove extra runners during fruiting to concentrate yield.
Harvest fully colored fruits every 2-3 days in cool morning hours.

symbolism.origin: In European and folklore traditions, the sweet red strawberry represents innocent perfection, modest sweetness, and loving affection.
